Q5651.reason: An 'as is' clause disclaims implied warranties but not an express warranty or description (a 1964 model) that formed part of the bargain, so Carol likely prevails.

Q5672.reason: An acquittal based on self-defense means the killing was justified and no crime occurred, so the instigator cannot be guilty. Insanity and diminished capacity are personal excuses that don't shield the accessory.

Q8537.reason: The concept of punishment should be defined in a value-neutral way so that its moral justification can be argued separately.
